title: Don't get ripped off! RTX 4070 Super vs RTX 5070: The Ultimate Comparison
description:
In this video I review the performance of the RTX 5070 head to head against the previous generation RTX 4070 Super, including a discussion of how to value DLSS 4 Multi-Frame-Gen.
